Brackenridge Health
Ms Chloe Bennett
Hospital number: BH-603845
Date: 5 October 2026
Your procedure: appointment and preparation
Dear Ms Chloe Bennett,
You are booked for a knee arthroscopy (left knee). Keyhole surgery: a small camera and instruments are passed
through tiny cuts to look inside and repair your knee joint. This letter tells you when and where to come, how to
prepare, and what to expect afterwards. Please read it carefully and keep it.
Your appointment

Date Thursday 19 November 2026
Please arrive at 07:00
Where Day Surgery Unit, Level 2, Brackenridge General Hospital
Anaesthetic General anaesthetic (you will be asleep)
Type of stay Day case: expect to be with us for about 6 hours
Eating and drinking
Do not eat anything after 2am on the day of your operation. This includes chewing gum and sweets. You can drink
water only until 6am.
Your medicines
(cid:127) Take your usual morning medicines with a small sip of water, unless told otherwise.

(cid:127) If you take blood-thinning medicines, call the pre-assessment team. Do not stop them without advice.
What to bring
(cid:127) A list of your medicines
(cid:127) Loose shorts or trousers
(cid:127) Flat, comfortable shoes
Please leave jewellery and valuables at home.
Going home
You must arrange for a responsible adult to take you home and stay with you for 24 hours. Do not drive until you
can do an emergency stop without pain. For most people this is 1 to 2 weeks.

Keep your leg raised when resting. Most people return to desk work within 1 to 2 weeks.
When to get help
Contact us straight away if you have any of the following:
(cid:127) Increasing redness, heat or swelling around the knee
(cid:127) A high temperature
(cid:127) Pain or swelling in your calf
(cid:127) Call 999 if you have chest pain or sudden breathlessness
